info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Meionite Jacket Detail-v1-spec
info.description: The Meionite Jacket Detail Management API enables users to create detailed entries for Meionite jackets within the product catalog. This functionality is essential for businesses looking to enhance their inventory with comprehensive item descriptions, specifications, and imagery. Typical consumers of this API include e-commerce platforms and inventory management systems that require accurate and detailed product data. This API streamlines the process of cataloging new jacket items, ensuring that businesses can effectively showcase their offerings.

post.summary: Create details for a Meionite jacket.
post.description: This endpoint allows you to create detailed information for a Meionite jacket. You can provide various specifications that define the characteristics of the jacket, ensuring that all necessary information is captured accurately.

requestBody.description: Specify the details for the Meionite jacket. This may include attributes such as size, color, and any specific customization options.

200.description: Successful request; details of the Meionite jacket retrieved.

meionite_jacket_id.description: The unique identifier for the Meionite jacket.

requestedBy.description: The name of the person or entity requesting the jacket.

isPriority.description: Indicates whether the request is a priority.

unitPrice.description: The price per unit of the jacket.

dimensions.description: The dimensions of the Meionite jacket.

tags.description: A list of tags associated with this jacket.

warehouseCodes.description: An array of warehouse codes where the jackets are stored.

width.description: The width of the jacket in the specified unit.

height.description: The height of the jacket in the specified unit.

unit.description: The unit of measurement for the dimensions (e.g., cm, inches).

Dimensions.description: The dimensions of the Meionite jacket including width, height, and unit of measure.
